title: Build multi-entry Commons with ATProto publication and ingestion
statement: Achim clarified and authorized planning a shared community architecture reached through repo navigation, search, CLI/MCP and community links. The attached specification and staged Claude build plan extend the existing local Commons rather than a single-door funnel. ATProto is a concrete adapter work package; external account activation remains separate.
conditions: User agreed the multi-entry/community direction and asked to spec and plan it for Claude; individual schema and deployment choices remain proposed.
Inspected implementation baseline: PR #8 at e24838fe25a7aa1e4c9648f8dee03ce159883b28; not merged when read.
Hosted knowledge at 58b9942 is complete but has timetable schema diagnostics, repaired separately in PR #4.
New work is documentation and planning only; no workers started, account posts, deployment or paid indexing.
Open activation choices: controlled NSID namespace, public account/provider setup, hosting and moderation ownership.
Affected documents: new specification, build plan and launch prompt. Older first-slice plan remains historical; its ATProto deferral is superseded only for the continuation scope.
